silhouette.reason: Pointed ears, long snout, black stockings and a fuller brush read as a red fox.
fixes: shorten the legs ~8% so it stops reading as a coyote

proportions.reason: Legs long and the chest narrow; body reads lanky for Vulpes vulpes.
fixes: shorten the legs ~8% and deepen the chest

materials.reason: Orange coat, cream chest and black legs separate, the brush has fur; the body coat is smooth with stray strands and the snow reads as white paint blobs.
fixes: denser, shorter fur cards on the body; snow as fine scattered flecks with sparkle, not blobs

detail.reason: Whiskers and brush fur present; face planes soft, no visible claws.
fixes: sharper cheek and brow planes; small dark claws

wear.reason: Snow dusting on the back (as asked) but it reads as white blotches; muddy paws.
fixes: snow as fine flecks concentrated on the topline; damp fur on the legs

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 legs are black now and the outline holds; the coat is faceted.
fixes: smooth the LOD2 coat colour per face

technical.reason: QA clean; 96k / 28k / 3k triangles over 4 draws; LOD0 heavy for a 1 m animal.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 80k by coarsening the fur-card density
